screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Set all five altars at the same height: the central altar in the middle, and a regular altar three blocks away to the north, south, east and west.

Put a Wolfsbane flower on each outer altar and a Moonbane Pearl in the center, then right-click the central altar with an empty hand.

The merchant sets out from at least sixteen blocks away and walks to you. If the way is blocked, he comes straight to the altar. Should the ritual fall through, your offerings are returned.

The Alpha Trial uses a different layout: a badge in the center and pearls around it.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.m:
A merchant stays for ten minutes (12000 game ticks), and also leaves if his chunk unloads. Once recruited, he becomes your long-term companion.

Each merchant offers six of nine possible trades at random, each in limited supply.

Moonbane Pearl: 6 Wolfsbane + 1 Diamond, or 12 Emeralds + 4 Wolfsbane
Werewolf Potion: 4 Wolfsbane + 2 Emeralds
Wolfsbane Potion: 4 Silver Ingots + 2 Emeralds
Silver and Wolfsbane: swap either way, 4 for 2

You can also trade Emeralds or Iron for Silver, and Emeralds for Wolfsbane.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
Once you are a werewolf and know Pack Oath, use a Werewolf Badge on a merchant and confirm. This spends one badge, and your new companion starts at tier 0.

Pack Oath sets your slots: one until you pass the Alpha Trial, then one per rank of the oath, up to three.

Every companion holds a slot, including while hunting or fallen. A companion you no longer need can be dismissed from the Pack tab: after a separate confirmation it leaves the pack and frees its slot, and whatever it carries is handed back to you.

Respeccing or being cured keeps each companion's record and items. Anyone over the limit rests, and returns at their old tier when you relearn the oath.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.c:
Follow: stays close and keeps moving. Monsters ignore it and it keeps following even when struck, though stray arrows, explosions and the environment can still reach it.

Guard: fights at your side. It joins your attacks, protects you when you are hit, and strikes back at whatever hurts it. It leaves creepers, your allies and pets, and PvP-protected players alone. Choose Guard when heading somewhere dangerous.

Rest: waits right where it is, ready to be recalled at any time.

Following and guarding companions rejoin you across dimensions. Changing orders clears the old attack target.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.i:
Move within eight blocks of your companion and choose Inventory on the Pack tab, or sneak-right-click the companion to open it directly.

The nine slots hold what you put there, plus the spoils of a hunt. Anything that does not fit stays where the companion returns.

Everything is kept if the companion falls.

Only the owner can open it.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.a:
The Appearance tab changes name and coat with a live preview on the left: drag to rotate, scroll to zoom. Choose Apply skin when you are happy.

The model follows the world setting, and Classic and Modern each remember their own coat. Names run up to 32 characters; save an empty name to use the coat's name.

The lower left of the Pack tab sets how all your companions address you, up to 16 characters, saved with the world. Default restores my lord.

Only you can see what your companions say.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.h:
A hunt takes your companion away for 1.5–3 MC days, with spoils settled on return. The bar on the Pack tab shows how far along it is.

Rewards depend on how long the hunt lasts and on your companion's tier. Spoils include common Overworld drops, ores and Wolfsbane.

You can recall early at any time, and the time spent so far is settled. Every hunt is followed by two MC days of rest.

Recall works across dimensions, and hunts run on the world clock.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.u:
Companions start at tier 0. Reaching tiers 1, 2 and 3 takes 2, 4 and 8 Moonbane Pearls, up to your Pack Oath rank.

Tier 0: Health 30, Attack 6
Tier 1: Health 40, Attack 8, Armor 10%
Tier 2: Health 50, Attack 10, Armor 20%
Tier 3: Health 60, Attack 12, Armor 30%

After five seconds out of combat, it heals 1, 1.5, 2 or 2.5 health per second.

Higher tiers earn more loot rolls on a hunt.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.r:
A fallen companion keeps name, coat, tier and inventory. Spend one Werewolf Badge on the Pack tab to bring it back at full health. Stand in the open: the badge is only spent when the revival succeeds.

Hunt rest keeps counting down through falling and revival.

Press C to open this window, or change it in Controls; Esc closes it.

Servers can switch companions with gameplay.enableCompanions. While off, records and items are kept and hunts and rest are paused, then resume when it is on again.
screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Have your companion tidy the storage around it:

1. Bring it to the middle of your storage, open the Sorting tab and choose Start sorting.
2. Chests and barrels within sixteen blocks of where it stands join the job, up to the nearest 64. The radar marks them.
3. It walks over, opens the lid, takes the items, carries them to their new container, and closes up.

Two methods:
Consolidate: gathers each item into the container that holds the most of it.
Merge stacks: tops up existing partial stacks.

Item frames: hang a filled item frame on a container and it keeps only that item. Matching items are brought in from elsewhere, and everything else moves out to plain containers. Frames match by item type, whatever the name or enchantments; one container can wear several frames, and an empty frame is only decoration.

Private storage: your companion passes over trapped chests and shulker boxes, so keep anything you want left as it is in those.

Items merge when the item and all its data match, and unstackable gear stays where it is unless a frame calls for it. Items change hands only as they are set down, so you can stop any time and everything stays in its container.

Containers in use, locked or protected and unopened loot chests are skipped for now and shown in gray on the radar. A container your companion cannot walk up to is still tidied from where it stands if it is within 32 blocks; only those farther away are skipped.

After a full round it stays on site and keeps watch; give any other order to end the job. Work pauses while you are offline or in another dimension, and resumes when you return.

Servers can switch this alone with gameplay.enableCompanionSorting.

screen.howlingwerewolf.companion.guide.s:
Companions are werewolf brothers sworn to you. Five steps bring your first one along:

1. Learn Pack Oath in the progression screen.
2. Build the altars: one central altar, with a regular altar three blocks away on each side, all at the same height.
3. Put a Wolfsbane flower on each outer altar and a Moonbane Pearl in the center, then right-click the central altar with an empty hand.
4. When the merchant arrives, use a Werewolf Badge on him and confirm.
5. Press C to open this window and give your first order.

After that, pick any chapter on the left.
